fields.v: Spec-first: research findings and a phased implementation plan with measurable success criteria are written before implementation and drive it, then validation checks the implementation against the plan; authors' wording: 'enables a spec-driven development workflow where specifications become executable, directly generating working implementations'. Not described as kept and maintained after implementation
fields.quote: This enables a spec-driven development [26] workflow where specifications become executable, directly generating working implementations.
fields.why: The value says 'Not Classifiable' and in the same field 'spec-first, plan-centred', which is contradictory; the six-phase workflow (plan before implementation, validation against plan criteria) fits spec-first.
fields.doubt: O campo diz 'Não classificável' e ao mesmo tempo 'spec-first'. Os autores falam de spec-driven development e o fluxo escreve o plano antes de implementar e valida contra ele (pág. 5, §4.3.1). Decide um só valor: spec-first ou não classificável.
